name: Banking Law & Negotiable Instruments
exam: AKNU Banking Law including Negotiable Instruments Act exam
new_code: name of the Act it belongs to (Negotiable Instruments Act 1881, Banking Regulation Act 1949, RBI Act 1934, Contract Act 1872)
example: Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881

episodes.t: The Banker Is Not a Trustee
episodes.s: Foley v Hill — what banking is, who is a customer, debtor-creditor and the special relationships, duties and rights
episodes.cover: Sec 5(b) BR Act definition of banking and Sec 6-8; who is a customer (Commissioners of Taxation v English Scottish and Australian Bank, Ladbroke v Todd); Foley v Hill and Joachimson — debtor and creditor; Shanti Prasad Jain; agent, bailee (lockers, Amitabha Dasgupta), trustee (Quistclose), lessor; Sec 31 NI Act duty to honour cheques and wrongful dishonour damages; secrecy (Tournier's four exceptions, Sec 13 of the 1970 Act); customer's duties (Macmillan, Greenwood) and the Indian position in Canara Bank v Canara Sales Corporation

episodes.s: Mohori Bibee — opening accounts, KYC, kinds of accounts, joint accounts, and the special customers
episodes.cover: Opening an account: introduction, KYC Master Direction, nomination Sec 45ZA (Ram Chander Talwar); current, savings, fixed, recurring deposits, DICGC, joint accounts and survivorship (Hirschorn v Evans); minors (Sec 11 Contract Act, Sec 26 NI Act, Mohori Bibee, Githa Hariharan); partnerships (Sec 19(2) Partnership Act); companies (Turquand, ultra vires, Sec 77 and 180 Companies Act); trusts; married women; pardanashin and illiterate persons; HUF; clubs; executors and agents; NRIs under FEMA

episodes.t: The Fixed Deposit and the Time-Barred Loan
episodes.s: PNB v Surendra Prasad Sinha — pass book, overdraft, drafts, appropriation and Clayton's case, set-off, safe custody, garnishee orders
episodes.cover: Pass book entries and the Bankers' Books Evidence Act; overdraft and cash credit; bank drafts Sec 85A; appropriation Sec 59-61 Contract Act and Clayton's case (Deeley v Lloyds Bank); right of set-off and combining accounts (Garnett v McKewan, Surendra Prasad Sinha) and its conditions; safe custody as bailment and lockers; garnishee orders under Order XXI Rule 46 (Rogers v Whiteley, Hirschorn), Sec 60 CPC exemptions (Radhey Shyam Gupta)

episodes.t: The Banker's Lien on the Fixed Deposit
episodes.s: Syndicate Bank v Vijay Kumar — lien, pledge, guarantee, documents of title, letters of credit and bank guarantees
episodes.cover: Sec 171 Contract Act general lien as implied pledge (Brandao v Barnett, Vijay Kumar), conditions and exclusions; pledge Sec 172-179 (Lallan Prasad, Morvi Mercantile Bank) and hypothecation; guarantee Sec 126-147 — co-extensive liability (Damodar Prasad, Indexport), continuing guarantee, discharge Sec 133-139, surety's rights Sec 140-141; documents of title under Sec 2(4) Sale of Goods Act — bill of lading, dock warrant, warehouse receipt, delivery order, railway receipt; letters of credit under UCP 600, autonomy, strict compliance, fraud exception; bank guarantees and injunctions (U.P. Co-operative Federation, Hindustan Steelworks)

episodes.s: Kundan Lal Rallaram — the NI Act, negotiability vs assignability, note, bill and cheque, analogous instruments, presumptions, holder in due course
episodes.cover: Sec 13 definition and essential features; negotiability vs assignability (Sec 130 TPA); promissory note Sec 4, bill of exchange Sec 5, cheque Sec 6 with electronic and truncated cheques; bank drafts, traveller's cheques, dividend warrants, hundis; Sec 118-119 presumptions (Kundan Lal Rallaram, Bharat Barrel); holder Sec 8 and holder in due course Sec 9 (Ponnappa Moothan) and the privileges Sec 20, 36, 42, 43, 46, 53, 58, 120-122

episodes.s: Great Western Railway v London and County Bank — kinds of cheques, crossing, endorsements, payment in due course, marking, refusal of payment
episodes.cover: Kinds of cheques; crossing Sec 123-131A — general, special, not negotiable Sec 130 (Great Western Railway, Wilson v Pickering), account payee (National Bank v Silke and the RBI direction), Sec 126-129; endorsement Sec 15-16, 49-56 — blank, full, restrictive, sans recourse, conditional, facultative, partial; payment in due course Sec 10; marking of cheques; countermand and the grounds on which a banker must refuse payment (Modi Cements, NEPC Micon)

episodes.s: Canara Bank v Canara Sales Corporation — liabilities of parties, forgery and alteration, paying banker's and collecting banker's protection
episodes.cover: Liabilities Sec 30-45; notice of dishonour Sec 91-98; noting and protest Sec 99-104; discharge Sec 82-90; forged drawer's signature (Canara Bank), forged endorsement (Bihta Co-operative), material alteration Sec 87 and Sec 89 (Macmillan); paying banker's protection Sec 85, 85A, 89, 128 (Kerala Marketing Federation); collecting banker's protection Sec 131 and its four conditions, negligence categories (Ladbroke, Underwood, Indian Overseas Bank v Industrial Chain Concern), the 2002 Explanations

episodes.s: Dashrath Rupsingh Rathod — Sec 138 to 148: offence, presumption, notice, jurisdiction, companies, trial, compounding, appeal
episodes.cover: Sec 138 ingredients and provisos (NEPC Micon, Modi Cements, Laxmi Dyechem, MSR Leathers, Alavi Haji, Sampelly, Indus Airways); Sec 139 presumption (Rangappa, Basalingappa, Bir Singh); Sec 142 complaint and limitation, Sec 142(2) jurisdiction after Dashrath Rupsingh and the 2015 amendment (Bridgestone); Sec 141 companies (SMS Pharmaceuticals, Aneeta Hada); Sec 143-148 summary trial, interim compensation, affidavit evidence, compounding (Damodar Prabhu, Meters and Instruments), Sec 148 deposit; Indian Bank Association 2014 and the 2021 Constitution Bench directions

episodes.s: Yes Bank moratorium — Banking Regulation Act: licensing, reserves, advances, RBI and Government powers, moratorium and schemes
episodes.cover: BR Act scheme and Sec 5 definitions; Sec 6-10D business and boards; Sec 11-24 capital, reserve fund, cash reserve, licensing Sec 22, branches Sec 23, SLR Sec 24; Sec 20-21A loans to directors and RBI control of advances (Corporation Bank v Gowda, Ravindra); Sec 29-31 accounts; Sec 35-36ACA inspection, directions, insolvency directions (Dharani Sugars), removal and supersession; Sec 44A-45 amalgamation, moratorium and scheme (Yes Bank, Lakshmi Vilas Bank, Axis Trustee); Central Government powers; Sec 46-49A penalties; Sec 56 co-operative banks after 2020 (Pandurang Chaugule)

episodes.s: Demonetisation case — RBI Act: constitution, currency, banker to Government, bankers' bank, monetary policy, NBFCs, promotional role
episodes.cover: RBI Act Sec 3-19 constitution, Central Board, Sec 7 directions, Sec 17-18 business and lender of last resort; Sec 22-28 note issue and Sec 26(2) demonetisation (Vivek Narayan Sharma, Jayantilal Ratanchand Shah); Sec 20-21A banker to Government, ways and means, public debt, Sec 47 surplus; Sec 42 scheduled banks and CRR; Sec 45ZA-45ZO Monetary Policy Committee and inflation targeting; Chapter IIIB NBFCs Sec 45IA-45N and Sec 45S (Peerless); credit information; Sec 54 and 46A-46D developmental role, NABARD, DICGC, Lead Bank, priority sector, financial inclusion; RBI and commercial banks summarised

episodes.t: The Day the Banks Became the People's
episodes.s: R.C. Cooper — nationalisation 1955-1980, effects, liberalisation and globalisation, recovery laws, NPAs
episodes.cover: 1949, 1955 SBI, 1968 social control, 1969 and R.C. Cooper, the 1970 Act, 1980; achievements and drawbacks; globalisation and Basel; Narasimham I and II, prudential norms, private and foreign banks, consolidation 2017-2020, governance reforms and privatisation debate; recovery laws — DRT Act 1993 (Delhi High Court Bar Association), SARFAESI Sec 13, 14, 17 (Mardia Chemicals, Transcore, Satyawati Tondon), IBC 2016 (Swiss Ribbons, Essar Steel); NPA cycle

episodes.s: Cosmos Bank heist — e-banking, IT Act, PSS Act, RBI guidelines, KYC, Ombudsman, fintech, e-rupee; offshore banking, IFSC, NRI accounts, FEMA
episodes.cover: E-banking channels — ATMs, cards, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, wallets, payments banks; IT Act Sec 3-5, 43, 66, 66C-66D, 72A; PSS Act Sec 3-4, 10, 23; NI Act electronic cheques; PMLA and KYC; RBI guidelines — internet banking 2001, mobile banking 2008, cyber security 2016, customer protection 2017 (zero and limited liability), payment aggregators 2020, digital lending 2022; Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021; account aggregators, sandbox, crypto (Internet and Mobile Association), e-rupee; offshore banking units, GIFT City IFSC and IFSCA Act 2019; FEMA Sec 3, 5, 6, 10, 13 and NRE, NRO, FCNR(B) accounts
